text: This office is busy but the service is excellent. The doctor takes his time to explain everything and the front office is very kind. Thank you 🙏

Todorovic agreed to remove my tear duct surgery suture and wrote me a new recipe for eye drops I had forgotten, even though he already had a very tight schedule, since I was traveling and had no possibility to wait. He was easy to communicate with via email and the procedure went well.

The clinic was easy to find, it was on the ground floor and had a big logo on the window. The cost of the visit was 100€ in total.

Good, professional service. It was possible to make an appointment during the weekend for an urgent case via WhatsApp.

I was traveling from the U.S. and staying in Tivat. I suddenly found myself needing an opthamologist to conduct an exam and rule out anything serious. We found Dr. Todorovic online and took a taxi out to see him. He communicated with me via WhatsApp on a Sunday, got us scheduled for the very next morning, was patient with us as our taxi got stuck in horrible traffic, and his staff stayed late and called us a return taxi. The office is clean. They spoke to me in perfect English and made me feel comfortable while faced with a scary situation. If you find yourself traveling (or if you live here) and need an opthamologist, I recommend him! Thank you, Dr. Todorovic for your professionalism and patience!
